description: This file defines an interface 'PreconditionHeader' for HTTP precondition headers based on RFC 7232, providing methods to retrieve header key and value and to check if a condition is met for a given object.

classes.name: PreconditionHeader
classes.description: Interface for all precondition headers according to RFC7232 - Section 3, generic over type T, providing methods to get header key/value and evaluate a condition.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of this header.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of this header.

methods.name: meetsConditionFor
methods.description: Determines if this precondition header meets the condition for the provided object.
